name: Alfhausen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alfhausen (a red six-pointed star on white under a red chief with a white zigzag bar).
history: The arms, designed by Waldemar Mallek, were approved by the Lower Saxon Minister of the Interior in 1952.

features.role: Alfhausen arms — star and zigzag bar
